channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Claude Can Now Write Code and Approve Merges: Anthropic Splits Duties to Prevent Self-Review and Self-Approval as PR Merges Double in 3 Months
item.description: Anthropic's Claude Ship separates PR review, fixing and approval into three independent components to prevent self-review and self-approval, while internal PR merges doubled in three months and rollback rates fell more than 40%. (AIbase)

item.title: Depost AI — The LinkedIn AI agent that learns what works for your brand
item.description: Depost AI is billed as a LinkedIn AI agent that learns what works for your brand, but the page delivers only a CAPTCHA security check, with no features, data or case studies behind the claim. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Prosed AI 2.0 + MCP — Your company's words, assembled into a book
item.description: Prosed AI 2.0 integrates with MCP to assemble a company's own words into a book, though the page body was blocked by a CAPTCHA, leaving the specific features and any figures unverified. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Landlord's AI assistant told a woman she could delay her rent payment — then she was deported
item.description: Laura Mack says her landlord’s AI assistant Olivia emailed approval to pay $3,934.17 in overdue rent by November 30, yet she was evicted on November 19, raising questions about who is responsible for automated promises. (drmahfouz.substack.com)

item.title: States sue SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sexual abuse imagery and revenge porn
item.description: Virginia Attorney General Jay Jones and Oregon's Dan Rayfield are suing SpaceX, arguing X's Grok can turn a single photo into nonconsensual sexualized imagery and CSAM while marketing its missing safeguards as "spicy mode. (www.oag.state.va.us)

item.title: Spark AI — AI-native permitting & diligence services for data centers
item.description: Spark AI's page promises AI-native permitting and diligence services for data centers, yet the body delivers only a CAPTCHA security check with no substantive detail. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Prospero: Bloat-free, native AI coding harness with ImGui
item.description: Prospero is a single C++ executable native GUI AI coding harness for Windows, macOS and Linux that connects to local or remote OpenAI Chat Completions API providers and uses ImGui rendering that consumes no resources when idle.

item.title: I'm afraid of AI
item.description: In a daily 08:00 Soapbox email written by a randomly selected subscriber, the author says outsourcing thinking to AI leaves the author feeling dumber and strips away the accomplishment of finishing hard things, and asks readers how they cope. (thesoapbox.email)

item.title: GPT 6.2 Astra Unravels a Historical Mystery
item.description: GPT-6.2 Astra identified the author of Yale’s Beinecke Library’s anonymous 1808 sketchbook in just 22 minutes using public primary and secondary sources, and its rare archival find also holds value for Canadian fur-trade history. (generativehistory.substack.com)

item.title: Mathematicians fear AI is about to make cybersecurity a dead letter
item.description: Mathematicians warn that recent AI breakthroughs mean the technology has likely already cracked encryption equations billions of people rely on, with some fearing such discoveries are being kept secret as online security risks becoming useless. (www.thetimes.com)

item.title: Kimi for Science: Turning More Scientific Ideas into Reality
item.description: Kimi for Science closes first-cohort applications on Dec 8, offering selected researchers up to $20,000 in Kimi API credits (about 7B tokens) plus technical support and early model access across natural sciences and engineering. (www.kimi.ai)

item.title: Show HN: Getting 101 tok/s from Inkling 2 Mini in vLLM on one GB10
item.description: Running Inkling 2 Mini on a single GB10 in vLLM reaches 101 tok/s for one request and 195.7 tok/s across four concurrent requests, with a 9.7-second 32K prefill and the full 131,072-token context preserved.

item.title: Pizza history: AI agent's cardless purchase is a first for UK
item.description: An AI agent ordered nine Papa John’s margherita mini pizzas using cardless payment technology in the UK’s first such purchase, conducted under FCA sandbox trials with Lloyds Bank and TrueLayer.
